historical_e00.current: None of those high findings remains. The baseline on 86649c0 had one high (body-parser, fixed here) and six moderate; four moderate development-only findings remain with the disposition above.
historical_e00.finding: E00 #15 retained seven inherited high-severity web development-tool advisories for E10 release-tooling sign-off.

applicability.backend: 14 Debian bookworm findings have no fixed version. The 6 PyPI findings (urllib3, msgpack, setuptools) are copies vendored inside the base image's system pip under /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/pip/_vendor; the application virtual environment cannot import them and pip is not run at runtime.
applicability.db: PostgreSQL 17.12 is the newest 17 patch. Remaining findings are 20 Debian items without a fix and the Go stdlib of the gosu entrypoint helper, which only drops privileges at container start; no newer upstream image changes them. PostgreSQL is unpublished on the private Compose network.
applicability.https: Caddy 2.11.9 is the newest upstream image. /usr/bin/caddy is a static binary (ldd: not a dynamic program), so the Alpine zlib, openssl and musl findings are in libraries used only by image tools such as curl and apk, which the runtime and health check do not run. The Go module findings (x/net, klauspost/compress) are inside the Caddy binary and await a published Caddy image; one high has no fix. The listener is loopback-only.

images.disposition: Remaining findings are accepted for this candidate with the reasons above and recorded for the E10 release gate (#13). Refresh the pinned bases again when upstream publishes fixed Caddy or PostgreSQL images, and repeat the S1 proof for that candidate.

python_backend.fix: uv lock --upgrade-package opentelemetry-api==1.45.2 (lock-only; FastAPI transitive). The application uses FastAPI's native trace context extraction only from HTTP headers, which cannot carry the newline the ReDoS needs; it was still patched because the package ships in the runtime image.
